We collaborate with businesses of all kinds and are pleased to offer special discounts, offers and promotions only available to the residents of Veris communities.
articles.title: Meet Our Sustainable Partners: Going Green Together

articles.summary: At Veris Residential, sustainability is a consideration in every aspect of our communities, from construction materials to community features. We pride ourselves in providing eco-friendly amenities that allow residents to engage with our sustainability initiatives in a concrete tangible manner.
articles.title: The Green Amenities & Features You Didn’t Know You Needed

articles.summary: Sustainable living shouldn't stop at your apartment door. While Veris Residential ensures our communities incorporate eco-friendly features and materials, residents can enhance their home's sustainability through thoughtful design choices and daily practices.
articles.title: Sustainable Interior Design: Eco-Friendly Style Tips for Small Spaces

articles.summary: When searching for an apartment, you're often looking for a home that welcomes not just you, but your animal companions as well. As of 2024, 66% of households in the United States own at least one pet. Unfortunately, many apartments have very restrictive guidelines about which animals they allow—from breed restrictions to size limits. While some regulations serve a purpose, finding the perfect home shouldn't mean leaving your beloved pet behind.
articles.title: Pets in Apartments: Tips for Keeping Your Furry Friends Happy
